findings.message: Authorization logic is inverted: the middleware now returns 403 for admin users and lets non-admin authenticated users through (next()). This both blocks legitimate admins and grants access to unauthorized users.
findings.suggestion: Restore the condition to `if (!user.isAdmin)` so only admin users proceed via next().

findings.message: The hunk adds a duplicate export of isAdminUser() while the same function already exists in the file (shown at line 49), causing a duplicate identifier/redeclaration error and making the module fail to compile.
findings.suggestion: Remove the newly added isAdminUser block; keep the existing definition only.
